test_title: PYST 56: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

O. went

P. yesterday

Q. we

R. to the

S. park
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **QORSP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "we," which is correctly indicated by **part (Q).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "went" **(O)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what action is being taken.
 
• **The next part,** "to the park," indicated by **(R)** and **(S)**, completes the destination.
 
• **Ending with** "yesterday" **(P)** provides the time reference.

Therefore, the correct answer is **QORSP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (RQOSP):** This option starts with "to the we went park yesterday." This sequence is grammatically incorrect and does not make sense.
 
• **Option 2 (OPQRS):** This option starts with "went yesterday we to the park," which is also incorrect as the subject and verb are not in the correct order.
 
• **Option 3 (PSROQ):** This option starts with "yesterday park to the we went," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
